citations.description: Ticket comment by RebarBotNava: 'Pushed as Gerrit change 1458 (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1458), commit 9bdb22f588 on worktree branch gitignore-2cf5 from origin/main 53b9c3e6dd. ... Awaiting LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1.'

findings.criterion: The change reaches `LLM-Review +1` and `Verified +1` on Gerrit and is submitted to `main`.
findings.detail: The ticket comment explicitly states 'Awaiting LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1' — the Gerrit change 1458 was pushed but the required labels have not been recorded as received. The ticket status remains `in_progress`. No attestation of the labels being granted or the change being submitted to main is present in the ticket.
findings.remediation: Once LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 are granted on Gerrit change 1458 and the change is submitted to main, record a ticket comment naming the Gerrit change URL, the label votes (who granted them and when), and the merge commit SHA on main.

data.remediation: How to resolve the unmet criteria: for each one, decide whether the work is genuinely incomplete or simply undocumented. If a requirement is already satisfied but the proof is not discoverable from the code alone, add a comment to this ticket that documents the evidence — cite the concrete artifacts that meet the requirement (file paths and line ranges, commands and their output, links, or the reasoning that ties the work to the criterion). The completion verifier reads this ticket's comments, so evidence you record there is taken into account on the next verification. For any criterion whose work is genuinely unfinished, complete it, then re-verify.
